items.event: El Clasico: Barcelona vs Real Madrid (La Liga MD10)
items.line: First Clasico of 2026-27 at Camp Nou; both clubs won their first three league games by early September, so it is an early title-credentials test. Kickoff is 21:00 CET (20:00 UTC) on Oct 25, the day clocks go back in Europe.
